reason: True supervised readout and nonlinear learning are verified, and original RW gains have positive paired family intervals. Conditional duration does not show incremental point-estimate advantage over key matched controls. The sole 320-cap sensitivity does not change this conclusion. This is a scoped scientific decision, not a universal journal threshold.
accepted_claims: The two signed damped trend features with supervised regularized readouts have measured predictive value relative to RW in this evaluation.
The original candidate and each nonlinear control executed positive optimizer updates.
The candidate permits continuation/retraction shapes as an architectural capability.
Original CEA performance was previously unscored in inspected project evidence, while raw/QC exposure predated this evaluation.
unsupported_claims: First invention of damping, exponential time bases, input-dependent decay, variable projection or privileged training information.
Conditional-duration increment established over static duration, same-capacity amplitude, free horizons and strong existing baselines.
Identified causal market shocks or fitted opposite-sign response coefficients in the primary market fits.
Generative temporal coherence or globally optimal/converged nonlinear fitting.
SOTA across published carbon forecasting methods or all markets.
